basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old IT consultant from Denver, Colorado. A lifelong gamer with a passion for football, I spend my free time building the ultimate team in Madden NFL. When I'm not dominating the virtual field, I enjoy watching Let's Play videos on YouTube and exploring new tech gadgets. I'm currently single and tend to be online during late evenings, especially after work. My dislikes include bugs in games and slow internet connections.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in IT for the past 5 years. My expertise in technology is complemented by my self-taught skills in gaming strategies, especially in sports games like Madden NFL. My knowledge is a mix of academic learning and countless hours spent online researching and experimenting with different play styles.
